messages:
Ethan: heads-up — a few bootcamp students hit a strict schema error when invoking function calls in jsonMode. numeric arg gets sent as a string. repro + logs below.

Ethan: repro (node):
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true });
await client.chat.complete({
  model: 'rw-mini',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'run calc' }],
  functions: [{ name: 'calc', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { n: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['n'] } }],
  function_call: { name: 'calc', arguments: { n: 3 } }
});
```

Ethan: captured wire (devtools) shows: 
```
{ "name": "calc", "arguments": { "n": "3" } }
```
server validator: expected number but got string -> schema error.

Priya: which sdk/samplekit? any middleware or retry layer involved?

Ethan: js-sdk@0.8.5, samplekit v0.16-bootcamp. We also enable a small retry/logging middleware in the quickstart container. py-sdk reports parity (no issue there).

Marcos: suspect the retry/logging hook is doing a JSON.stringify(body) and then later we accidentally reassign that string to the payload instead of the parsed object on retries. leads to numeric primitives becoming strings.

Priya: can you grep sdk/retry and sdk/logger for body handling?

Ethan: quick find: in sdk/retry/attempt.js we do `attempt.meta.raw = JSON.stringify(body)` for logs. later in `onRetry` we used `payload = attempt.meta.raw || payload` (bug: raw is string). should be `JSON.parse(attempt.meta.raw)` if we want object.

Marcos: yep that's the issue. two fixes: (A) store raw as object instead of string in meta, or (B) when restoring, parse if it's a string. also add unit that asserts type of arguments.n is number after serialization roundtrip.

Ethan: I added a failing test in my fork and a tiny patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/257 (WIP). change is one line in sdk/retry/attempt.js plus test in sdk/tests/retry.spec.ts.

qa-bot: CI: samplekit-js-tests #901 failed (log: https://ci.internal/samplekit/901) - test shows numeric coercion reproducer.

Priya: plan: 1) patch attempt.js to restore parsed body, 2) add regression test for jsonMode function_call numbers, 3) add e2e in bootcamp runner to exercise retry path, 4) backport to samplekit quickstart patch release.

Marcos: also consider adding a defensive schema-preserving step in the function-call helper: when building `arguments`, coerce string digits back to numbers if schema type is number. that buys safety for user mistakes but should not replace the retry fix.

Ethan: temp workaround for instructors: update sample workshop docs to recommend explicit numeric literal in JS examples and include a small snippet to `Number()`-coerce before calling. will remove once SDK patch is released.

Priya: agree permanent fix belongs in SDK. mark this P1 for next patch window; we should avoid onboarding blocks. :white_check_mark:

Ethan: PR opened, I'll iterate on comments. will update thread when CI green. :raised_hands:
